title: Canonical counit-normalized transport of ordinary completed-coefficient pullback
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $A$ in universe $t+1$, and let $h:S\to T$ be a morphism of schemes in universe $t$. Use the ordinary total left derived module pullback along the canonical completed coefficient map of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] and the exact derived module pullback $d.\mathrm{pull}(h)$ of [def-weil-pbc-exact-pullback-interface]. The completed coefficient maps, ordinary module pullback functors, and their functors on cochain complexes agree by their specified section formulas. Define $u_h:\mathrm{completedOrdinaryPullback}(h,d)\simeq d.\mathrm{pull}(h)$ as the unique natural isomorphism satisfying the universal resolving-counit normalization of [def-cbc-completed-pullback-counit-transport]: for every cochain complex $P$, its component at $Q(P)$ followed by the exact-derived factorization of the module pullback equals the resolving counit of the ordinary total derived pullback, after the specified equality of module-pullback complexes. This is the unique normalized ordinary comparison, before completion of its values. Existence and uniqueness determine its data; no completeness, open immersion, boundedness, or isomorphism assumption on $h$ is imposed.
